answer: Reaching eligibility takes 75 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. The trellis register is checked at draw time, pulse lists the eligible set, and karst seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 75 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 5 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
